skilltree.name: cave-teams-volume
skilltree.description: The front door — cave-teams as one dependency-ordered course.

children.name: cave-teams
children.description: The one idea: everything is a Link; agent = team = world; the >> / | operators.

children.name: cave-inprocess
children.description: The in-process plane — .execute() threads a Python dict through the links. The topologies you compose with the DSL.

children.name: cave-sequential
children.description: Run agents in order; each reads the previous output. The >> operator.

children.name: cave-parallel
children.description: Run agents concurrently on the same input; outputs merge. The | operator.

children.name: cave-branch
children.description: Route to the first agent whose condition holds. choice().

children.name: cave-conditions
children.description: The message state machine — how a topology compiles to guardrail conditions.

children.name: cave-gate
children.description: Loop an agent until an evaluator approves (always terminates). gate().

children.name: cave-dag
children.description: Arbitrary dependency graph of agents; sequential is the linear limit.

children.name: cave-dovetail
children.description: Typed hand-off of named data between agents. dove().

children.name: cave-tournament
children.description: N agents compete, a judge picks the winner. tournament().

children.name: cave-leader-spine
children.description: The leader-driven plane (the real runtime) — messages are FILES, a leader routes them, a guardrail gates turn-order. The part the flat forest under-taught.

children.name: cave-run-team
children.description: The runtime entry points — run_team (pure) and cave_team (ephemeral CAVE server + live dashboard).

children.name: cave-leader
children.description: The leader loop — propose one message per step, broadcast, concurrent teammates, the guardrail, raw|llm|file modes.

children.name: cave-messages
children.description: The file substrate — a message IS a JSON file, dispatch is a pointer, the session dir layout.

children.name: cave
children.description: Metacontrol — build/run ANY team from a plain-data spec; the team_run op drives the leader-driven plane; the golden library; scan across projects.

children.name: cave-worlds
children.description: Leader-driven server teams — agents collaborating on shared state over rounds. Built on the spine.

children.name: cave-blackboard
children.description: N agents read/write a shared board over rounds with a mutator (stigmergy arena). blackboard().

children.name: cave-metacog
children.description: A team that reflects on its own run — metacognition over the event stream.

children.name: cave-season
children.description: Repeated rounds with carried state — a season of play.

children.name: cave-sim
children.description: A simulation world of interacting agents.

children.name: cave-evolve
children.description: Evolve/select over agent configs across generations.

children.name: cave-world
children.description: The gameworld — the composed world pattern (NPCs, nested worlds).

children.name: cave-teams-learner
children.description: The testing machine — force every topology to RUN with real agents and read the interactions (not pass flags). The powerset-agent way.
